program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1000

policy.validation_strategy: cheap PMID/entity screening during authoring; full repository validation only after Wave 1000

waves.focus: 2025 network meta-analysis of probiotic strains/combinations in adults with T2D; glycemic effects are strain/product and disease-population specific, and ranking does not equal head-to-head superiority.
2025 network meta-analysis of turmeric preparations for knee OA; product/formulation identity and network-comparison limitations retained.
2025 CKD-specific RCT meta-analysis of inflammatory, lipid, hematologic and anthropometric markers; disease-population surrogate evidence only.
2026 umbrella review of 45 systematic reviews/129 associations; broad multi-outcome evidence with GRADE credibility differences across endpoints.
2025 knee-OA systematic review/meta-analysis; pain/function findings remain short-term, indication-specific and preparation-sensitive.
2024 umbrella meta-analysis of prior OA meta-analyses; useful for consistency/heterogeneity assessment but not a substitute for formulation-specific RCT evidence.
2025 systematic review of 30 trials in T2D/prediabetes/metabolic syndrome; modest glycemic signals plus mechanistic microbiome readouts, with intervention classes kept separate.
2025 knee-OA RCT meta-analysis of serum inflammatory biomarkers; biomarker findings remain distinct from patient-reported pain/function efficacy.
2025 16-RCT T2D meta-analysis; FBG/HbA1c/TC/LDL signals with 2-h glucose, insulin, HOMA, TG, HDL, liver/kidney, weight and BMI nulls.
2024 30-study glycemic meta-analysis; FBS/HbA1c signals with insulin and HOMA-IR nulls and extreme heterogeneity.
2026 31-trial metabolic-disease meta-analysis; modest weight/BMI/BP/glycemic changes with central-adiposity and insulin-resistance nulls.
2025/2026 ED systematic review/meta-analysis of randomized trials; erectile-function evidence remains indication-specific and separated from testosterone/bodybuilding claims.
2025 eight-RCT/372-participant meta-analysis; SBP/DBP and waist signals with weight and BMI nulls.
2024 54-RCT/3,000-participant inflammation meta-analysis; CRP/IL-6 reductions with TNF-alpha null and high heterogeneity.
2025 umbrella review of chia meta-analyses; broad health claims graded by AMSTAR-2/GRADE, preserving low-certainty and inconsistent outcomes.
2025 systematic review/meta-analysis of moderate-high-dose astaxanthin and lipid profiles; lipid endpoints remain dose/formulation dependent.
2025 meta-analysis in overweight/obese adults; intermediate-disease-marker evidence only, with heterogeneous populations and surrogate endpoints.
2025 systematic meta-analysis of RCTs on cardiovascular/metabolic markers; multi-endpoint cardiometabolic evidence with no event-level inference.
2024 updated randomized-trial meta-analysis of anthropometric indices; weight/BMI/waist effects remain preparation/population dependent.
2025 CRP dose-response meta-analysis; inflammatory biomarker evidence remains surrogate and distinct from clinical anti-inflammatory efficacy.
2024 glycemic systematic review/meta-analysis; FBG/HbA1c/insulin evidence is limited by a small heterogeneous RCT base.
2023/2024 sex-hormone meta-analysis; FSH, SHBG, testosterone, free-androgen index and DHEAS were not significantly changed—useful endocrine counterweight.
29-RCT metabolic-syndrome meta-analysis; FPG/TG/HDL/waist/SBP signals with DBP and BMI nulls.
2025 updated 26-RCT glycemic synthesis; FBG/2hPPG/HbA1c/insulin signals with HOMA-IR null and substantial heterogeneity.
Metabolic-syndrome RCT meta-analysis of lipid and glycemic indices; disease-population and endpoint specificity retained.
